title: Focaccia
description: A classic Italian flatbread with olive oil, rosemary, and olives, baked until golden and crisp.

method.instruction: Brush a rectangular tin with oil or melted butter. Combine yeast, water, and sugar in a large bowl, stirring to dissolve the yeast. Cover and leave in a warm place for about 10 minutes or until frothy.
Add oil. Sift 3 cups of the flour, milk powder, and salt into the yeast mixture. Beat with a wooden spoon until well combined. Add enough of the remaining flour to form a soft dough.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes or until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a large lightly oiled bowl, brush surface with oil, cover with plastic wrap, and leave in a warm place for 1 hour or until well risen.
Punch down the dough and knead briefly. Roll out to fit the prepared tin. Cover and leave to rise for a further 20 minutes.
Using the handle of a wooden spoon, press indentations into the dough at regular intervals.
Brush the surface with combined olive oil and garlic. Top with olives and rosemary, then sprinkle with oregano and coarse salt.
Cover and leave for a further 30 minutes or until well risen. Preheat oven to moderate 180°C.
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until golden and crisp. Cut into large squares and serve warm.
